title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(宮城克徳研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Miyagi Katsunori)
keywords: Environment & Power energy 2.Power system insulation 3.Power apparatus 4.Impulse discharge 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Educational programs focusing on basic knowledge and skills in the fields of electrical and electronics engineering, which are highly important, develop highly creative electrical and electronics engineers who have acquired problem-finding, solving, and applied skills. Based on electric power distribution facility, this course study mainly from a viewpoint of the integrated evaluation between Materials, Apparatuses and Systems.
advice: This course is positioned as a subject which integrates the contents studied with all the subjects while it has assumed the last subject with a series of Design Project programs started by the Design Project / Introduction. The purpose of this project is learning advanced technical knowledge while reviewing the basic subjects through experiment and theoretical examinations of these project themes. Research fields and General subjects 1. High-voltage substation facility field - General subject: The investigation of behavior-analysis and life-time in the internal insulation phenomena in the equipment using various biodegradable insulation oils, and the verification for practical applications 2. Power system field - General subject: Influence of the electrical degradation and investigation of the degradation mechanism caused by natural environment in power transmission and distribution systems
requiredKnowledge: This course refers to the references (mainly scientific paper) relevant to research activities. Especially, fundamental English grammar and technical vocabularies are reviewed because English papers increase in number. In the experiment, always accompanied by danger to deal with high-voltage equipment and many medicine. Be sure to follow the professor's directions.

activityGoals.body: While being able to explain purpose and details of research, draws up the research plan and can perform it.
Communications are taken with the member and teacher in a laboratory, subject points are clarified.
While learning positively the current knowledge in the field, the result of research can be analyzed.
The points of the research results can be arranged in presentation data.
The results of research can be summarized in the project report.

The results of research can be published to the related societies and it can obtain higher outside evaluations.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. The approximate account of the contents in the research task can be performed, and the subject points can be analyzed. 2. According to the contents of the plan, it is executable. 3. The results of research can be summarized in the project report. 4. The related societies can publish the results of research.
